headline: Steven Gerrard names Premier League wonderkid to watch: 'I have seen enough'
description: Tottenham academy prospect Luca Williams-Barnett has shown in just a few moments why he is definitely a young player "to look out for," according to former England captain Steven Gerrard.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Real Madrid tracking Arsenal's Calafiori
description: Real Madrid are monitoring Arsenal defender Riccardo Calafiori as a primary target to strengthen their left back position. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Boy, 14, arrested for Bradley Lowery taunt at Sunderland fans
description: A 14-year-old boy has been arrested after social media footage appeared to show a Coventry fan taunting Sunderland supporters about Bradley Lowery.

headline: Man City relegated from Premier League but win Champions League? How it could play out
description: What would happen to Man City's superstar players if they get relegated from the Premier League but qualify for Champions League?

headline: Liverpool's $500m forward line is failing. Can they turn it around?
description: Liverpool's star-studded, expensively assembled attack has scored fewer Premier League goals this season than Ipswich. That needs to improve immediately.

headline: Moyes after second Everton win over Newcastle: 'Not an easy thing'
description: David Moyes hailed a "great result" for Everton as they secured back-to-back wins over Newcastle United with a 1-0 triumph at St James' Park on Monday.
